name: Queen of Thieves
source:
Being a starving artist isn't so romantic, until you're swept up in a heist by the Gilded Poppy: the world's most infamous thieves! They steal only the rarest of the rare and this time their target is...you!? Are you ready for a world of con games, daring escapes, and thrilling romance?

[From in-game description]
translation:
成为一名挨饿的艺术家并不那么浪漫，直到你被镀金罂粟卷入抢劫：世界上最臭名昭著的小偷！他们只偷稀有中的最稀有的东西，这次他们的目标是……你！？你准备好迎接充满骗局游戏、大胆逃脱和惊心动魄的浪漫的世界了吗？

[摘自游戏内描述]
